section.heading: ## Lists (proteinjs ui) — a table can show a heading over each group of its rows
section.text: - A table can show a heading over each group of its rows, as a list already can, however many pages of rows it has loaded; a table with no groups looks and works as before.
smoke: - In a space, open the Chats list: its rows sit under day headings (Today, Yesterday and earlier).
- Scroll a long Chats list until more rows load: each day still has one heading.
